versions.changelog:
- Initial release of RSS Aggregator skill.
- Monitor, filter, and summarize RSS/Atom feeds on a schedule.
- Supports keyword filtering, date filtering, and outputting article summaries.
- Includes ready-to-use Python scripts and multiple example automation recipes.
- Can route feed digests or alerts to Discord, Notion, or webhooks.
- Troubleshooting tips and feed discovery guidance provided.
